category_title: Students with mild intellectual disabilities showing academic engagement, off-task, and problem behaviors
minimal_context: The student is asked to copy sentences from the board into their notebook during a standard classroom lesson.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please copy the sentences written on the board into your notebook.

STUDENT: (Picks up the pencil but starts playing with it instead of writing, looking around the classroom.)

TUTOR: You need to write what is on the board.

STUDENT: (Puts the pencil down and turns to look outside through the window, ignoring the notebook.)

TUTOR: Are you doing your work?

STUDENT: (Continues looking out the window, tapping the pencil on the desk, attending to other things irrelevant to the lesson instead of engaging in the academic task.)

options.A: Provide an app that gives instant rewards with audio and text for copying.
options.B: Explicitly incorporate elements that promote self-compassion during the copying task.
options.C: Provide examples when giving explanations about the sentences on the board.
options.D: Keep the student busier on the class work during the copying task.
